description:
Licenciada en Psicología | Atracción y Desarrollo del Talento en ICBC Argentina | Talent Acquisition Specialist | Talent Acquisition Partner |…

¡Somos el Banco más grande del mundo y queremos seguir creciendo con VOS!

En ICBC, trabajamos para potenciar el talento de nuestra gente, innovamos para evolucionar, promoviendo un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y la mejor experiencia para nuestros clientes y equipos

Buscamos personas que vibren nuestra cultura y nuestro propósito , con ganas de sumar, de aportar, de animarse, ¡de intentar! de crear desde la diversidad de miradas, que nos potencia y enriquece. Que nos acompañes y seas parte de la transformación de nuestra banca , aportando tu perspectiva creativa, ¡innovadora!

En esta oportunidad buscamos Analista Business Intelligence Semi Senior para sumarse al equipo de Data & Analytics – Business Intelligence.

Te contamos cuál es el objetivo de la posición:

Realizar análisis cruzado de datos internos, utilizando capacidad para descubrir patrones, tendencias y oportunidades en la información que maneja el área. Este rol tiene como propósito generar insights valiosos que aporten profundidad analítica a la toma de decisiones.

• Analizar información proveniente de múltiples fuentes (comportamiento digital, transaccional, etc.) para detectar insights, patrones y anomalías.

• Formular hipótesis de valor, diseñar análisis y validar resultados con foco en impacto.

• Elaborar reportes analíticos que combinen datos, visualizaciones claras y narrativas accionables.

• Proponer mejoras en los tableros y reportes existentes para aumentar su poder explicativo.

• Trabajar en conjunto con equipos técnicos (BI, Data Engineering, Data Science) para enriquecer modelos y generar sinergias.

• Aportar una mirada analítica a proyectos estratégicos del banco, ayudando a identificar oportunidades latentes o no exploradas.

• Comunicar hallazgos de forma clara y convincente a líderes del área y otras partes interesadas.

  • Experiencia en análisis de datos con Teradata SQL y Microstrategy (excluyente).
  • Formación en carreras afines al rol.
  • Dominio de lógica analítica, formulación de hipótesis y validación con datos.
  • Curiosidad y pensamiento crítico: capacidad de ir más allá de lo evidente.
  • Autonomía para investigar, proponer y construir análisis sin esperar pedidos explícitos.
  • Capacidad para articular con equipos diversos y enriquecer discusiones con una mirada basada en datos.

¡Será un plus!

Contar con conocimientos en Excel avanzado, Python o herramientas complementarias.

• Soft Landing: Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para madres y padres.

• Cotización preferencial en productos bancarios.

• Bonificación en plataformas de entrenamiento y bienestar para membresía en gimnasios.

• ¡Y muchos beneficios más!

title: Portfolio Manager - Real Estate
description:
Se você respira mercado imobiliário, tem paixão por estratégia e quer liderar com impacto real, essa pode ser a sua próxima grande missão.
Na Suno Asset, a gente joga grande — mas joga junto. Nossa vertical de Real Estate já ultrapassou R$ 1 bilhão sob gestão e está só começando. Por aqui, buscamos gente com profundidade técnica, visão de longo prazo e vontade fora do comum pra ajudar a construir uma das maiores plataformas de fundos listados do Brasil.
Estamos buscando um(a) Portfolio Manager - Real Estate para assumir a gestão de três dos nossos fundos listados: SNCI11 (CRIs), SNFF11 (FoF) e SNME11 (multiestratégia). Uma vaga estratégica, com muita autonomia e visibilidade de mercado — inclusive liderando o time de gestão para potencializar o crescimento da Suno Asset. Mas mais do que isso: construiremos juntos, uma história de longo prazo com valor real.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
 O que você vai fazer no dia a dia:

  • Definir e conduzir a estratégia de alocação dos fundos, sempre com visão de cenário macro e alinhamento ao mandato de cada produto.
  • Liderar o time que atua com originação, análise, diligência e monitoramento dos ativos.
  • Participar de comitês de investimento e representar a Suno em conversas com stakeholders: originadores, consultores, administradores e investidores.
  • Criar processos, análises e rotinas que combinem profundidade com agilidade.
  • Representar a Suno Asset no mercado com transparência, conteúdo e autoridade técnica.
  • Trabalhar com liberdade e responsabilidade, com autonomia real pra tomar decisões de impacto.

O que esperamos de você:
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo 7 anos) com fundos imobiliários, preferencialmente em CRIs, FoFs e estratégias híbridas.
  • Histórico de liderança de times técnicos e estratégicos.
  • Domínio técnico em análise de crédito, estruturação, avaliação de ativos reais e mercado de capitais.
  • Clareza na comunicação, visão de longo prazo e postura de dono(a).

Requisitos e qualificações
 Requisitos:
  • Formação em Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Certificações como CGA, CFA, MBA ou similares são diferenciais.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança.

Vai se destacar se tiver:
  • Sido responsável por estratégias com bom histórico de performance.
  • Uma pegada de construção de produto e não só de operação.
  • Trabalhado em times ágeis, onde o impacto aparece rápido.
  • Interesse genuíno por educação financeira, inovação e tecnologia.

Informações adicionais
 O que oferecemos para quem lidera com excelência:
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico com cobertura ampla;
  • Seguro de vida executivo, segurança e tranquilidade fazem parte de uma liderança responsável.
  • Parcerias institucionais estratégicas, com acesso a cursos, mentorias e serviços que fortalecem sua jornada como líder.
  • Programa de bônus competitivo, alinhado com performance e impacto.
  • Desconto no Wellhub (Gympass) e no Zenklub — corpo e mente em dia!

Não é só sobre gerir ativos — é sobre construir um legado, ajudar a transformar a forma como as pessoas investem no Brasil. Com responsabilidade, com profundidade e com visão de futuro.
Se você quer mais do que uma cadeira — quer desafio, crescimento e impacto —, vem com a gente.

title: Esteticista Massoterapeuta - Itu -SP
description:
Além de realizar a aplicação de todos os nossos protocolos de estética e bem-estar, os profissionais técnicos Buddha Spa são responsáveis por entregar o bem-estar de forma ampla, atuando em todos os aspectos de rituais de atendimento e experiência do cliente dentro de cabine.
Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional técnico passa por um importante processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para estar apto a atuar no padrão de excelência da marca.
Horário de trabalho: O profissional atua em média 7 horas por dia, com uma folga fixa durante a semana e um sábado fixo de folga. Aos domingos o trabalho é feito por escala, normalmente dois domingos no mês.
Contratação: Realizamos contrato de parceria com a terapeuta, via Lei do Salão Parceiro (Lei 13.352/2016). Você deverá abrir um MEI/CNPJ.
Remuneração: Remuneração através de repartição de resultados dos atendimentos, ou seja, recebem uma porcentagem em cima dos procedimentos realizados.
Possuímos um importante plano de crescimento e incentivo. São inúmeros benefícios trazidos de acordo com o tempo de parceria e crescimento em nossa escala de desenvolvimento.
Bronze – 20%
Prata – 25%
Ouro – 30%
Diamante – 35%

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e estados. Nossas unidades estão localizadas em imóveis de rua, dentro de hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias, sempre buscando nos aproximar de nossos clientes.
Com foco em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecemos mais de 25 tipos de terapias, desde massagens corporais, banhos, tratamentos estéticos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos exclusivamente voltados para o público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.
A essência do trabalho do Buddha Spa se assenta nos valores do “sentir-se bem”, em todos os aspectos. Buscamos entregar a nossos clientes muito mais do que o atendimento técnico de cada serviço, propiciando uma experiência única. O despertar dos 5 sentidos é a base do atendimento de nossos clientes, os quais usufruem de uma infra-estrutura de alto padrão totalmente voltada para o bem-estar: sons, aromas e chás complementam o toque profissional de cada um de nossos terapeutas.

title: Senior Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description:
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Regulatory Reporting Analyst, LATAM

Adyen is seeking a Senior Regulatory Reporting Analyst LATAM to be based in our Sao Paulo office, which is responsible for Adyen’s Prudential and Statistical reporting in LATAM. This role reports directly into the Global Head of Reporting, part of our Amsterdam-based Group Finance Function.
It’s one of Adyen’s core responsibilities to report Prudential and Statistical data to national regulators around the globe. Adyen’s national regulators include the Dutch Central Bank (NL), the Federal Reserve (USA), and the Bank of England (UK).

As the Senior Regulatory Reporting Analyst, you will play a key role in managing Adyen’s regulatory reporting requirements in Brazil and Mexico, helping to build a connection between Adyen’s Group Finance and Risk functions and the Banco Central do Brasil (BACEN) and Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (CNBV).

Adyen obtained a Payments Institution’s license in 2023 in Brazil and the acquirer registration in 2024 in Mexico to enable its own-acquiring. As Adyen and its regulatory requirements grow, this is an unique opportunity and the perfect moment to step in and start building the Brazilian regulatory reporting function.
As part hereof, we expect you to be able to translate Brazilian and Mexican regulatory reporting requirements in the context of Adyen’s non-traditional business model and explain this in dialogue with regulators. You will be in the lead optimizing reporting processes with scale and automation in mind and take Adyen’s regulatory reporting function in LATAM to the next level.

What you’ll do

  • Build the Brazilian and Mexican regulatory reporting framework
  • Lead regulatory reporting projects including scoping and implementation of regulatory changes (BACEN and CNBV)
  • Report directly to the Global Head of Reporting
  • Strengthen the connection between the business and Group Finance / Reporting, supporting Adyen’s global strategy through its regulatory strategy
  • Translate the impact of complex transactions and roll out of new products into financial and regulatory reporting for LATAM and for the Adyen Group
  • Own the LATAM reporting requirement overview, communicating regularly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and timely implementation and delivery
  • Manage and prioritize the workload in line with the reporting requirements and other project timelines
  • Drive simplification, standardization, and automation of regulatory reporting while supporting the team in the preparation of regulatory reports, such as recurring reports on capital and liquidity requirements as well as statistical reports

Who you are

  • You have at least 5 years of experience with regulatory
  • You have a fluent level of Portuguese and English, both written and spoken. Spanish is a must
  • You have direct working experience with the BACEN and/or CNBV Regulatory Framework and the corresponding regulatory reporting from a financial institution, consultancy or Big 4 company

title: Regional Technical Service Manager, Poultry (LATAM & Africa)
description:
Overview

We Are Kemin

We are visionaries who see things differently and are inspired by the world around us. We have been dedicated to using applied science to improve the quality of life for over half a century.

Kemin is a privately held, family-owned company with over 3,300 employees worldwide and manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, India, Italy, Russia, Singapore, South Africa, and the United States. For more than 60 years, Kemin has focused on applying science to improve quality of life, producing over 500 specialty ingredients for humans and animals in the feed, food, health, nutrition, and textile sectors. Kemin serves customers in over 120 countries.

The vaccine business is a strategic priority for Kemin. The company invests in the development and production of advanced vaccine solutions, in addition to its established ingredient portfolio. Vaccine innovation is a core part of Kemin’s long-term strategy for growth in animal health.

Kemin Biologics

Kemin Biologics works in close collaboration with veterinarians and customers to understand local needs. Together, we can create and innovate, delivering customized vaccine solutions to support your animal health business.

Responsibilities

KEMIN BIOLOGICS is seeking a:

REGIONAL TECHNICAL SERVICE MANAGER, POULTRY (LATAM & Africa)

The Regional Technical Service Manager (TSM) focuses on Latin America & Africa and will operate withing the marketing department. The Regional TSM is responsible for the marketing, technical and scientific support of the regional marketing and sales teams regarding our global poultry vaccine platforms. As part of a global team you contribute to the strategically drive and support Kemin’s vaccine business across the globe by leveraging and scaling the local Kemin expertise and insights on a global scale

Mission of the team:

The Regional TSM will report to the Global Technical Service Manager at Kemin Biologics and will work in close collaboration with team members in the different areas and business units. The team aims to strategically drive and support Kemin’s poultry vaccine business across the LATAM and Africa regions by leveraging local Kemin expertise and insights.

What you’ll be doing:

You are the driving member of our strategic marketing and technical initiatives for the poultry vaccine platforms across LATAM and Africa. This consists of:

  • Responsible for leading our poultry vaccine platforms in the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • Drive the strategic marketing and technical support for our poultry vaccine platforms.
  • Analyze market developments and shares in LATAM and Africa and provide a strategy to maintain or reach the Top 10 players for the key market segments in which we participate.
  • Develop robust regional technical and marketing plans.
  • Design and implement the “Go to Market” strategy at a regional level for LATAM and Africa.
  • Oversee Brand life cycles from a strategic planning perspective and work on “Renovation” or “Innovation” to extend the product life cycle, including the planning of field studies to support these efforts within the regions and product launching activities.
  • Actively work on publications and publication strategies relevant to the regions.
  • Involve key thought and market leaders from LATAM and Africa to support the positioning of our platforms and transfer these insights to our teams.
  • Translate relevant regional field issues and customer challenges in poultry health into solutions to support our local sales, technical, and marketing teams and ultimately our customers.
  • Participate in and attend local and regional exhibitions, seminars, trainings, and workshops within LATAM and Africa.
  • Support R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams where needed, by collecting technical information and trial results from the regions.

Qualifications

What we expect from you:

  • University degree in Veterinary Medicine, ideally with a specialization in poultry health.
  • Field experience managing the health status of poultry, preferably with experience in the LATAM and/or Africa markets.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with an understanding of customer needs in diverse cultural contexts.
  • Excellent writing skills (English) and the ability to provide adequate synthesis.
  • A high degree of personal motivation, a desire to make an immediate contribution, and a sense of urgency.
  • Experience working effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Fluent in English. Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or French is highly desirable to effectively cover the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • A track record in regional technical or marketing management.
  • Experience in a technical/commercial business in animal health with a focus on poultry.

Working Conditions:

  • You will be home office based or based at one of our regional headquarters and will travel across the globe (50% of your time annually).

What is in it for you:

  • Join a highly motivated and truly global team that is rapidly expanding its footprint in the vaccine industry.
  • Continued learning opportunities - Kemin recently launched a corporate university with online and in-person training opportunities for growth and development throughout your entire career.
  • The chance to give back to our world - Through our foundation of servant leadership, we are proud to offer ample service opportunities. Kemin has a valued corporate partnership with both The World Food Program and Habitat for Humanity, in addition to many local initiatives.
  • A competitive financial package - in addition to your salary, we offer an uncapped bonus opportunity and fringe additional benefits.

TYPICAL NUMBER OF DIRECT REPORTS: N/A

In Kemin’s culture, this position may be required to perform additional duties as needed. The above noted document is not intended to describe, in exhaustive detail, the multitude of tasks that may be entailed with the position, but rather to give the team member a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations. As the nature of business demands change, so too do the essential functions of the position.

Overview
WELCOME TO SITA
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

As a Procurement Graduate, you will support the Sita Procurement team in mitigating risk, reducing costs, and collaborating with suppliers and partners to drive innovation and generate new ideas for Sita's customer solutions. Your role will be crucial in assisting the Americas Region team of Managers.
What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with the America’s team and stakeholders to provide procurement support for sourcing, contracting, and administration activities.
  • Conduct market research to support the creation and maintenance of best practice sourcing activities for the Americas.
  • Handle day-to-day administrative, research, and tactical support activities, including using the RFQ tool.

  • Provide timely reports related to the role's scope.

Qualifications
ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

  • Languages fluency in English & Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Solid skills in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Specifically good command of Excel skills.

  • Capability to work in cross-functional teams within multinational business operations.

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Technical Producer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Technical Producer to join the Creator Platform team. In this position, you’ll work with both client and services teams to identify timelines and solutions to make ecosystem-wide features (UEFN). You’ll work to build scalable solutions for all Fortnite games and have opportunities to interact with teams across the company, including LEGO, Fall Guys, Rocket League, and Unreal Engine. With your help, this team will make a significant impact, making sure creators can create unique experiences, development timelines move forward, and players can enjoy experiences across our titles.

In this role, you will

  • Own the outcome - No matter the complexity or challenges, ensuring that our products launch and operate successfully
  • Meeting the daily needs of coordinating your team’s work are the basics. Delivering new features and services to end users and seeing complex features through the complete integration cycles with other teams is the fun part
  • Own the schedule - partner with discipline leads to determine the time and people necessary to see projects through to completion
  • Build and maintain project plans, schedules, and roadmaps, considering dependencies across multiple development teams to ensure successful releases
  • Communicate - Provide transparency on project status and risks to stakeholders in order to ensure they are properly informed of any impacts from upcoming releases. Communicate frequently with the rest of the production team and project leads on project status, risks, and opportunities
  • Focus on Users – Be an active customer advocate and ensure live issues affecting end users are being followed up on and resolved
  • Utilize tools like Jira, Google Suite, and Miro to organize work and maintain product roadmaps that directly drive development

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience working in a production or project management role where you've managed cross-functional teams in the creation and delivery of technical projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working with software development teams, particularly in a game environment (not required, but nice) or wearing multiple hats (product, project, program)
  • Ability to coordinate work and ensure collaboration between teams across multiple time zones
  • Experienced in working directly with developers and formulating methodologies that work for teams
  • The ability to work East Coast hours is preferred as the position will interact with teams across PST and GMT (UK)

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Job Description Summary:
This job investigates customer activity across multiple platforms to ensure that it falls within acceptable parameters established by governing bodies including, but not limited to, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) and the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC). Your efforts will be in accordance with PayPal’s Ethics and Compliance Standards, and obligations to the appropriate regulations. You will be tasked with ensuring that PayPal implements the appropriate monitoring and controls of customer activity to ensure that PayPal is satisfying its obligations to the appropriate regulatory authorities. You will demonstrate the ability to understand opposing points of view on highly complex issues and to negotiate and integrate different viewpoints with all levels of GFC&CP leadership.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Utilize advanced analytical techniques to assess complex information sets, enabling the formulation of logical and well-supported recommendations for reporting to global regulatory bodies and internal stakeholders. These investigative decisions are essential to fulfilling PayPal’s fiduciary responsibilities under international regulations, which mandate effective monitoring of customer activities to detect and report suspicious activities, including money laundering and terrorist financing.
  • Conduct comprehensive end-to-end reviews of potential illegal or suspicious activities, ensuring thoroughness and accuracy in all investigations.
  • Perform timely and detailed analyses of instances of potential Anti-Money Laundering (AML) activities and suspicious financial transactions across diverse jurisdictions and countries, adhering to local and international compliance standards.
  • Evaluate customer profiles and analyze large datasets to confirm that activities align with expected norms, ensuring compliance with Acceptable Use Policies and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations.
  • Leverage both internal data and various open-source research platforms to investigate potentially illicit activities, thereby supporting informed investigative decisions
  • Document findings in a narrative format within both manual and automated case management systems and prepare comprehensive reports for management as required.
  • Consistently exercise sound judgment in making decisions and recommendations related to case investigations, ensuring alignment with global best practices and regulatory requirements.

Job Description
Location: São Paulo, Hybrid
Are you obsessed with TikTok and Instagram, memes and understanding why certain content goes viral? If you love creating, identifying trends and want to work on real campaigns, this position is your gateway to the dynamic world of a hyper-growth tech startup.
You'll explore daring creative angles, test innovative ideas and contribute to performance marketing strategies. From concepting to trend research, your ideas will drive high-impact, scroll-stopping campaigns.
About Luzia
Luzia, the fastest-growing consumer-facing AI company in Europe and Latin America, is looking for a creative mind with a passion for social media to join its Brazilian team as a social media analyst.
With over 60 million users in less than two years, our mission is to become everyone's favorite personal assistant, simplifying and enriching everyday life.
Recently named one of Europe's 100 hottest startups by WIRED and ranked among the world's top generative AI apps by Andreessen Horowitz, Luzia is backed by top investors and is growing fast. This is your chance to embark on a transformative journey that unites creativity, growth and cutting-edge technology.
What makes you the ideal candidate

  • Studied Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Film, Journalism or related areas.
  • Fast-learning mentality: Adaptability, curiosity and a constant desire to explore new creative and AI tools.
  • Creative Instinct: Sharp eye for trends, visual storytelling and attention-grabbing content.
  • Social-First Thinking: Passion for social networks, viral content and the latest ad formats.
  • Confidence in Front of the Camera: Comfortable expressing themselves in videos in an engaging and authentic way.
  • Data-Driven Creativity: Uses data and performance insights to enhance ideas and amplify the impact of content.
  • Strategic Thinking: Understands what drives content performance and analyzes creative success. Creates coherent and effective communication strategies and guidelines.
  • Team Collaboration: Enjoys co-creating with marketing professionals, designers and creators in a dynamic environment.
  • Proactivity and Initiative: Focused on solutions, autonomous and always looking to take ideas forward.
  • Comfortable working in English.
  • Desirable: Solid analytical skills and experience with performance marketing platforms and tools (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, Apple Search Ads, Appsflyer, Google Analytics, etc.).
How you'll make a difference
  • Track trends, top apps and viral content to identify engagement triggers and turn them into data-driven creative ideas.
  • Analyze high-performing creatives, extract key learnings and share insights to optimize future results.
  • Collaborate with the team to turn insights into creative strategies and participate in the entire content production process - from scripting and shooting to editing and publishing.
  • Support A/B testing of creative and use performance insights to improve campaigns.
Why work with us?
 At Luzia, you'll have the opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup, contributing to products that are transforming the AI space. Our culture is collaborative, innovative and deeply purpose-driven. If you're passionate about artificial intelligence, love solving complex problems and are looking to make a significant impact, we want to meet you!
Our Culture and Values
 We live and breathe agility. Our culture is guided by a "launch, experiment, iterate, launch" mentality, where action, experimentation and rapid execution are key. Our team is collaborative, innovative and driven by a strong sense of mission.
So... ready to co-create with the fastest-growing AI in Europe and Brazil, develop your skills and help make Luzia everyone's favorite assistant? Let's do it! ????

title: Construction Schedule Analyst
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Construction is the 2nd largest industry in the world (4x the size of SaaS!). But unlike software (with observability platforms such as AppDynamics and Datadog), construction teams lack automated feedback loops to help projects stay on schedule and on budget. Without this observability, construction wastes a whopping $3T per year because glitches aren’t detected fast enough to recover.
Doxel AI exists to bring computer vision to construction, so the industry can deliver what society needs to thrive. From hospitals to data centers, from foreman to VPs of construction, teams use Doxel to make better decisions everyday. In fact, Doxel has contributed to the construction of the facilities that provide many of the products and services you use everyday.
We have classic computer vision, deep learning ML object detection, a low-latency 3D three.js web app, a complex data pipeline powering it all in the background. We’re building out new workflows, analytics dashboards, and forecasting engines.
We’re at an exciting stage of scale as we build upon our growing market momentum. Our software is trusted by Shell Oil, Genentech, HCA healthcare, Kaiser, Turner, Layton and several others. Join us in bringing AI to construction!
The Role:
Doxel is using Artificial Intelligence to build and label three dimensional models to make their analysis clear, concise, and accurate. As a Construction Scheduling Analyst at Doxel, you'll be visually analyzing and labeling complex blueprint-style documentation and models of our customer sites.
As a Construction Scheduling Analyst at Doxel you’ll be responsible for performing complex analysis of customer projects. You’ll be charged with understanding the results of the Doxel engineering team’s analytics output, comparing those analytics with standards in the construction industry, and helping us understand how to improve.
What You’ll Do:

  • Construction Schedule Analysis – Analyze project schedules to classify activities for internal tracking operations. Analyze critical path and float for inclusion in system reporting
  • Product Data Analysis - Analyzing and verifying data generated for customer reports from scan data compared to a design 3D model using proprietary techniques developed by Doxel’s elite engineering team
  • Report Generation and Verification - Generating customer schedule and reports within the agreed upon SLA (service level agreement). Working with the Product and Engineering team to identify improvements to reports
  • File Organization and Transfer - Monthly customer files will need to be consolidated and uploaded within a timely manner into a location set and directed by the Doxel Product Team for access by engineering tools and internal team members
  • Maintenance, R&D, Debugging - R&D, and Debugging may need to be conducted as coordinated by the Doxel Product Analyst technical team. Requirements to support this effort are to be available during working hours, practice attention to detail, follow directions, and provide documentation when requested
  • Communication - Ongoing communication throughout the workday will be required
  • Various tools are used for communication with Slack as the primary messaging platform. Jira tickets and tracking are also used. Direct Phone Calls and Conference Calls (Zoom as an option) may also be used
  • Training – Office Training, including all necessary communication and processing software platforms used for Doxel operations, will be provided by the Doxel Product team. Training will begin with various initial onboarding sessions. As Product Operations Analyst knowledge increases, further training will be provided to expand on various topics of expertise

What You Bring to the Team:
  • 3+ years of experience in the construction management, with a strong focus on creating and managing project schedules
  • Bachelor degree or greater in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering
  • Experience working on data center, hospital, or biopharmaceutical projects
  • 1+ years of experience creating technical reports for customers
  • Experience with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project scheduling software
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be fluent in English

Preferred:
  • 3+ years of experience in the construction industry creating and managing project budgets
  • 3+ years of experience in project management in the construction industry
  • Experience with Synchro scheduling software
  • Experience with construction project estimating and cost management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

Doxel is an equal opportunity employer and actively seeks diversity in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Benefits:
  • Paid time off
  • Flexible work hours
  • Work from home

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
Join to apply for the Analyst, Infrastructure role at GIC

Join to apply for the Analyst, Infrastructure role at GIC

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.
The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.
Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.
We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What Impact Can You Make In This Role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.
What You Will Do As An Analyst

  • Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
  • Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
  • Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
  • Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
  • Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
  • The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.

What makes you a successful candidate?
  • Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
  • Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
  • Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
  • You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
  • Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.

Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.
Learn More
Learn more about our Infrastructure Department here: PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

title: EvoluTI 2022 foca na evolução do profissional de Tecnologia da Informação
description:
Home Analytics EvoluTI 2022 foca na evolução do profissional de Tecnologia da Informação

Já em sua 5ª edição, o EvoluTi nasceu com a missão de reunir profissionais de TI em busca de um mesmo propósito: evolução profissional. No dia 07 de dezembro, o evento totalmente gratuito será no formatohíbrido, com transmissão ao vivo e versão presencial no Espaço Villa Glam, localizado no bairro de Moema, na cidade de São Paulo.

Com palestrantes como Glauter Jannuzzi, Community Leader of Global Influencers da Microsoft, Marc Tawil, top voice e Learning Instructor do LinkedIn,Anderson Palma, Founder da Growth Labs, entre muitos outros, essa é a oportunidade de entender sobre os assuntos mais quentes do mercado de Tecnologia da Informação e de fazer networking com uma comunidade colaborativa e engajada. Interessados podem realizar a inscrição aqui .

Ao longo de cinco anos, o EvoluTI auxilia na difusão de uma cultura que une conceitos de Anywhere Office, Life Long Learning e Intraempreendedorismo, estimulando a capacitação técnica e comportamental de profissionais do mercado. “O evento é realizado com o objetivo de fortalecer a comunidade de TI no país, proporcionando conexões entre IT Pros, parceiros e estudantes, que podem trocar experiências, falar sobre o futuro e conhecer as soluções mais inovadoras do mercado. Mais do que desenvolver habilidades técnicas, também temos como missão o estímulo das soft skills. Queremos ser vetores de conhecimento para ajudar a formar profissionais cada vez mais completos. “, diz Carolina Lagoa, estrategista de negócios e cofundadora da Witec, hub de tecnologia responsável pela realização do evento.

A edição anterior contou com mais de 600 inscritos no formato presencial e 2.000 no on-line, além de ter sido apoiada por nomes como Microsoft, Oracle e Intelbras.

The RN Clinical Consultant, Disability Claims serves as a clinical resource for the investigation and assessment of medical information regarding disability by providing comprehensive medical reviews and analysis of long-term disability claims. You will be responsible for restrictions, limitations and duration impacting functional capacity based on medical data, to assist the Claim Managers in determining claim liability. In addition, you will collaborate with treating providers to assist individuals to obtain appropriate care and ensure optimal treatment outcomes and acts with urgency and ownership to resolve customer issues and prioritize the customer experience. You will also review long and short-term disability claims to determine the impact of claimants’ medical condition on their function as well as the impact of their medical treatment in achieving improved functional outcomes.
You are

  • Well versed with a strong clinical background in understanding and applying rationale of how injury or illness may impact the claimant’s function.
  • Excellent with verbal and written communications and able to gather and report information accurately, ask appropriate questions to facilitate partnership with treating providers, claimants, and internal partners to encourage participation of claimant in appropriate treatment goals.
  • Able to work collaboratively with internal vocational rehab specialists in identifying opportunities for return to work.
  • Experienced in identifying and resolving customer issues, when possible, to enhance the customer experience.
You will
  • Review and assess claimant subjective reports and objective medical evidence to determine the impact of medical conditions on function. Clarify medical information, interpret medical reports, and evaluate restrictions and limitations to assess current and ongoing level of impairment. Apply current medical knowledge regarding diagnosis, treatment, prognosis, and impairment. Participate proactively through early assessment of medical issues, work capacity and RTW opportunities.
  • Conduct analysis of claimant’s current treatment plan and collaborate with health care providers and claimants to promote accountability for the appropriateness and status of treatment plan and length of disability. Plan for ongoing case management through proactive partnering with treating providers to move claimants toward appropriate care.
  • Serve as a technical resource on the medical aspect of the claim. Identify opportunities to educate claim staff and peers on medical aspect of disability.
  • Provide ongoing training and mentoring to claims staff and peers regarding issues impacted by the nature of injury or illness and its impact on function in work or daily activities.
You have
  • A valid RN license from an accredited school of nursing.
  • Proficiency in multiple computer systems required.
  • CCM preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience, with at least 2 of those years within an acute care setting.
  • Disability experience strongly preferred.

AgileEngine is one of the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies in the US and a top-3 ranked dev shop according to Clutch. We create award-winning custom software solutions that help companies across 15+ industries change the lives of millions.
If you like a challenging environment where you’re working with the best and are encouraged to learn and experiment every day, there’s no better place - guaranteed! :)

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Partner with sales and business teams to identify client needs and participate in sales calls to shape compelling AI offerings;
- Collaborate with clients to define AI roadmaps, prioritize use cases, and translate business needs into actionable AI solutions;
- Design and lead proof-of-concepts (PoCs) using Generative AI (e.g., LLMs, RAG pipelines, agents) and Predictive AI (e.g., forecasting, classification, clustering);
- Act as a trusted strategic advisor, helping clients understand where AI fits in their product or data journey;
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from early consulting phases to implementation;
- Contribute to proposals, workshops, and documentation for AI adoption initiatives;
- Optionally: Evangelize our capabilities by writing, speaking, or mentoring internally.
MUST HAVES
-5+ years of AI/ML experience , with proven delivery of both predictive and generative AI solutions in business settings;
- Demonstrated consulting experience (e.g., client-facing, pre-sales support, fractional CTO work, or agency consulting);
- Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools and models (e.g., OpenAI GPT, Claude, open-source LLMs, vector databases, LangChain/RAG architectures);
- Experience building or advising on predictive modeling pipelines, using tools like scikit-learn, XGBoost, Prophet, etc.;
- Strong communication skills: able to present to executives and business users, explain technical concepts, and tell compelling data stories;
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and MLOps best practices is a plus;
- Self-starter mentality with the ability to kickstart projects, shape ambiguous goals, and move fast with confidence;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Prior experience in fractional CTO roles or acting as a strategic technical advisor;
- Background in startup consulting, product ideation, or venture-backed AI/ML companies;
- Experience with multi-modal AI (e.g., text, image, audio) or agent-based systems;
- Public speaking, writing, or AI evangelism contributions.
THE BENEFITS OF JOINING US
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

About Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

About Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.
This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.
You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.
You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.
 What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.
  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.
  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.
  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.
  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.
  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)
  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.
  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.
  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.
  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.
Soft Skills:
  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.
  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.
  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.
Nice to Have
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts
What it's like to work at Darkroom:
  • We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in LA, The Bay Area, New York, Philly, Sao Paulo, Lisbon, and Eastern Europe.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Skills in scripting and process automation.

  • Wellbeing support, and so much more.
And outside of this, you’ll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes, join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.
Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.
At Entain, we do what's right. It's one of our core values and that's why we're taking the lead when it comes to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive future - for our people, and the wider global sports betting and gaming sector. However you identify, our ambition is to ensure our people across the globe feel valued, respected and their individuality celebrated.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced technology and commercially savvy, Sales Engineer to support the sale of advanced fraud prevention and risk solutions, with a specific focus on solutions such as, Featurespace, VCAS, Network Scheme agnostic solutions and a strong working knowledge of Visa Protect offerings. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the sales process by providing deep technical sales expertise, delivering compelling product demonstrations, and ensuring seamless integration of Risk and Identity Issuing solutions. This role requires a thorough understanding of client systems and the ability to support direct sales efforts effectively. You will work alongside the sales team to provide technical sales expertise on fraud prevention solutions, and help in presenting these solutions to potential clients. The goal is to ensure that the sales team has the necessary technical support to successfully sell the company's advanced fraud prevention and risk scoring products.

Key Responsibilities:
• Technical Sales Expertise: Serve as the technical expert throughout the pre-sales lifecycle, working with prospects to position Risk and Identity solutions including but not limited to Featurespace’s adaptive behavioral analytics alongside or integrated with Visa Protect and other third-party fraud solutions.
• Value Articulation: Understand and articulate the value of both ARIC Risk Hub and Visa Protect (such as Visa Advanced Authorization, Risk Manager, Visa Secure) in addressing specific fraud challenges across the payment lifecycle.
• Client Advisory: Advise on how to combine Featurespace machine learning models with Visa’s network-based intelligence and decisioning to enhance fraud detection efficacy and reduce false positives.
• Sales Support: Provide technical sales support throughout the sales process, including responding to RFPs, creating technical documentation, and addressing inquiries.
• Product Demonstrations: Conduct detailed and tailored product demonstrations to prospective clients, showcasing the value and capabilities of Issuing Risk and Identity solutions.
• Industry Awareness: Maintain deep awareness of evolving fraud vectors, regulatory frameworks (e.g., PSD2, EMV3DS, AML), and industry trends affecting digital payments and financial crime.
• Client Requirements Translation: Translate requirements into actionable technical solutions, ensuring that Risk and Identity products meet and exceed expectations.
• Implementation Collaboration: Collaborate during the product implementation phase to ensure a successful go-live within the designated timeline.

Why this is important to Visa: This role is crucial in ensuring that Visa remains at the forefront of fraud prevention and risk management. By providing technical expertise and supporting the sales process, the Senior Manager, Sales Engineer helps to secure new business and maintain strong relationships with existing clients. This role directly impacts Visa's ability to deliver innovative and effective fraud solutions, ultimately contributing to the company's success and reputation in the industry.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications
•8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications
•Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field.
•10+ years of experience in pre-sales, fraud strategy, or technical consulting roles within fraud prevention, payments, or financial services.
•Direct experience working with or integrating Visa Protect solutions (e.g., Visa Risk Manager, Visa Advanced Authorization, Decision Manager, or Visa Secure).
•Hands-on experience with Featurespace’s ARIC Risk Hub or similar machine learning-based fraud platforms.
Deep knowledge of:
•Adaptive behavioral analytics, supervised/unsupervised ML models
•Transaction monitoring, alerting, scoring, and model tuning
•Payment ecosystem fraud detection (card issuance, acquiring, gateways, wallets)
•Decision orchestration and fraud policy design
•Technical familiarity with various APIs scripting, data mapping, and solution architecture.

Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
As a Senior Lead Data Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in driving data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, visualization, and output interpretation to provide actionable insights that optimize our workforce strategies, especially related to Talent Management, Performance, and Employee Experience. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity and deliver impactful analytical solutions.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Analysis and Interpretation: Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform workforce strategies and business decisions.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with HR, business leaders, and other stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide tailored analytical solutions that answer their critical questions and drive business outcomes.
  • Collaboration with Data Teams: Work closely with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data is clean, structured, and ready for analysis. Participate in designing scalable data pipelines and architectures to support analytical workflows.
  • Insights and Data delivery: Utilize data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and design presentations using PowerPoint to deliver compelling visualizations that communicate basic to complex analytical insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Advanced Insights: Surface hidden insights using statistical techniques (e.g., ANOVA, Regression) to uncover drivers of performance or why some groups are more engaged than others to drive business performance.
  • Data Quality: Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across your projects. Collaborate with data governance teams to align processes and maintain high data quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities: Monitor requests and find opportunities to automate frequent asks, streamline and help enhance efficiency in our processes, products, and cross-collaboration.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Skills And Experience
  • Have a bachelor or master degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, IT or related areas.
  • Fluent English
  • Show strong experience in data analysis, visualization, and interpretation.
  • Proficiency with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Strong proficiency with data management and analysis tools, such as SQL, Python or R, Excel
  • Experience designing compelling data stories on presentation tools, such as PowerPoint is preferred
  • Formal training in quantitative related fields
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience with simple to advanced analysis, such as descriptive statistics, ANOVA, and regression is preferred.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Curious and self-starter
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.
This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.
You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.
You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.
 What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.
  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.
  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.
  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.
  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.
  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)
  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.
  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.
  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.
  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.
Soft Skills:
  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.
  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.
  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.
Nice to Have
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in LA, The Bay Area, New York, Philly, Sao Paulo, Lisbon, and Eastern Europe.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Cultura que nos move
Somos movidos por propósito, autonomia e entrega de valor real.
Acreditamos em feedback constante, em times pequenos com alto impacto, e na construção de tecnologia que transforma a vida de quem mais precisa.
No Dr. Consulta, acreditamos que o respeito e a diversidade são essenciais para criar um ambiente onde cada pessoa possa ser autêntica. Valorizamos as singularidades de todos, incluindo Pessoas com Deficiência, Raça, Etnia, Idade, Gênero, Crenças, Orientação Sexual e Identidade de Gênero. #SejaVocêAqui

O Dr.Consulta nasceu com um propósito claro: transformar o acesso à saúde no Brasil. Desde 2011, quando abrimos as portas do nosso primeiro centro médico em Heliópolis, escolhemos fazer diferente — oferecendo um atendimento acessível, de qualidade e centrado em quem mais precisa. De lá pra cá, já impactamos a vida de mais de 3 milhões de pessoas nos nossos 28 centros médicos na Grande São Paulo.
Aqui, cada consulta, cada análise de dado, cada "bom dia" é um ato revolucionário. Porque para nós, esperar não é uma opção. Acreditamos na ação, na responsabilidade de fazer agora — e melhor — para transformar realidades.
Nossa jornada é movida por esforço, coragem e um compromisso diário com a reinvenção da saúde. E nessa missão, a tecnologia é nossa aliada. Usamos dados e soluções inteligentes para criar processos mais simples, rápidos e sustentáveis, que ampliam nosso impacto positivo na vida das pessoas.
No Dr.Consulta, trabalhamos ao lado de pessoas inconformadas, determinadas e resilientes. Gente que acredita na força da diversidade, da colaboração e da inovação como caminho para mudar o sistema — de dentro pra fora.
Somos um time que entende que o futuro que a gente sonha começa com o que escolhemos fazer hoje. E a nossa escolha é clara: fazer com excelência, superar resultados e seguir transformando a saúde no Brasil.
Acreditamos que transformar a saúde começa por quem está com a gente todos os dias. É por isso que valorizamos talentos diversos, apaixonados por impacto social e movidos por propósito.
Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, que incentiva a inovação, a autonomia e o crescimento contínuo, o seu lugar pode ser aqui com a gente.
No Dr.Consulta, recrutamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos, vontade de fazer diferente e coragem para assumir grandes desafios. Temos oportunidades em diversas áreas — da tecnologia à operação, da clínica à gestão — e queremos conhecer pessoas que compartilham da nossa missão.

description:

A Onfly é uma startup focada em ajudar as empresas a viajarem melhor!

Nosso objetivo é democratizar a gestão de viagens, reembolsos, descontos em passagens, hotéis e locação de carros, oferecendo uma experiência completa e simples.

Somos reconhecidos como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar no Brasil, inclusive sendo uma das empresas do Great Place to Work.

Para alcançar um crescimento exponencial, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, que desejem fazer parte de uma equipe de alta performance e que queiram evoluir bastante.

Para a vaga de Tech Lead Sênior , procuramos um profissional responsável por liderar um dos nossos Squads de tecnologia focados em IA, tanto na gestão quanto no desenvolvimento. Buscamos alguém dinâmico, que saiba trabalhar em equipe e que se conecte com nossa cultura e valores.

  • Liderar, orientar e mentorar a equipe, promovendo crescimento profissional e autonomia técnica.
  • Conduzir e participar de revisões de código (code reviews), assegurando qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenção das soluções.
  • Definir e promover melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e MLOps.
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico, auxiliando na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Colaborar com a gestão na definição de prioridades, planejamento do roadmap técnico e gerenciamento do backlog.
  • Projetar e arquitetar sistemas de IA robustos e escaláveis para produção.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e implementação de pipelines de dados, treinamento de modelos e inferência.
  • Garantir desempenho e estabilidade dos modelos de IA em produção através de monitoramento, otimização e re-treinamento contínuo.
  • Explorar novas tecnologias, frameworks e modelos de IA para manter a empresa na vanguarda da inovação.
  • Documentar arquiteturas, processos e decisões técnicas de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio para entender desafios e traduzi-los em soluções de IA.
  • Comunicar de forma eficaz o progresso, desafios e resultados dos projetos de IA para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Contribuir para a visão de longo prazo da área de IA, identificando oportunidades para impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior como líder técnico;
  • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Sólido conhecimento em desenvolvimento Python;
  • Experiência com APIs REST ou GraphQL (consumo e construção);
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL, com foco em performance;
  • Conhecimento em Docker para desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e comunicação com fornecedores;
  • Perfil autônomo, proativo e colaborativo.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

  • Experiência com LangChain, LangGraph ou AutoGen;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs, com foco em controle de tokens e contexto;
  • Experiência com fluxos RAG, CoRAG, Self-Refinement;
  • Conhecimento sobre segurança na execução de código dinâmico e isolamento;
  • Avaliação de performance e custos de agentes inteligentes;
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source ou iniciativas de IA.

Benefícios:

  • Regime de trabalho híbrido (1 dia presencial e restante remoto);
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;

  • Budget de R$1.000 anual para cursos e certificações;
  • Descontos em Graduações e Pós-graduações (UNA e UNIBH);
  • Assistência funeral (Grupo Zelo);
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
  • Voucher de R$200 no Onhappy para viagens com desconto;
  • Seguro de vida.
